5082 telikoutos {tay-lik-oo'-tos} 陰性 telikaute {tay-lik-ow'-tay}

源於 03588 和 02245 以及 03778 的複合字; 代名詞

欽定本 - so great 3, so mighty 1; 4

1) (體積) 如此巨大 (#雅3:4|)
2) (程度上) 如此重大,重要,浩大 (#林後1:10;來2:3;啟16:18|)

5082 telikoutos {tay-lik-oo'-tos} feminine telikaute {tay-lik-ow'-tay}

from a compound of 3588 with 2245 and 3778;; pron

AV - so great 3, so mighty 1; 4

1) of age
   1a) of such an age
   1b) of so great an age, so old
   1c) so young
2) of so great a size, in bulk
3) such and so great
